description: React component for managing and configuring permission schemes in Mattermost admin console, including roles, permissions, and UI interactions.

classes.name: PermissionSystemSchemeSettings
classes.description: React component class for permission scheme settings in Mattermost admin console.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state and roles needed.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads roles if needed and handles URL query for row selection.

methods.name: UNSAFE_componentWillReceiveProps
methods.description: Updates roles in state when new props are received.

methods.name: goToSelectedRow
methods.description: Scrolls to the selected permission row in the UI.

methods.name: selectRow
methods.description: Selects a permission row and scrolls into view.

methods.name: loadRolesIntoState
methods.description: Loads roles data into component state.

methods.name: deriveRolesFromAllUsers
methods.description: Derives specific roles from 'all users' permissions.

methods.name: deriveRolesFromGuests
methods.description: Derives guest roles from guest permissions.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles saving role permissions to the server.

methods.name: toggleRole
methods.description: Toggles the open/closed state of role sections.

methods.name: togglePermission
methods.description: Toggles specific permissions within a role.

methods.name: haveGuestAccountsPermissions
methods.description: Checks if guest account permissions are enabled.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the permission scheme UI, including permission trees and controls.
